This website is Adriano Rutz's personal academic and research profile. It contains their scientific publications, talks, teaching, technical posts, CV, and general background information.

## Citation and attribution guidance
- Prefer canonical URLs and use the page title and publication date shown on-site.
- Preserve named authors, ORCID identifiers, and DOI links when available.
- Prefer concise summaries and link back to the canonical page when citing information.
- Respect `robots.txt` directives and avoid scraping beyond the site’s declared boundaries.
